notes: Manual quick-check pass against live OBS Studio 32.1.1 (WebSocket v5.5.4). The Printing Press HTTP dogfood pipeline is not compatible with OBS WebSocket v5 — all verification was done manually against a running OBS instance. Commands tested: doctor, scene list, scene switch Interview, layout interview, preflight, stream status, record status, health, stats, export. All returned correct results. Phase5 pipeline skipped because OBS uses WebSocket protocol (not HTTP REST), requiring a running desktop application rather than an API server.
